# IToldYouSo Computing

> London-wide Point of Sale (POS), till, and Electronic Point of Sale (EPOS)
> system installation specialist and same-day Information Technology (IT)
> engineering service. Based in Hampstead (North West London) and attending
> client sites across all of Greater London, including Central, North,
> North West, East, South, and West London.

## Flagship Service: London POS, Till & EPOS Installation

IToldYouSo Computing designs, supplies advice for, installs, and troubleshoots
turnkey till and POS systems for retail shops, cafes, restaurants, takeaways,
salons, clinics, and market stalls across London-wide sites.

- Core Till & EPOS Platforms: Square (Register, Stand, Terminal), SumUp
  (Solo, 13-inch Countertop Register), Zettle by PayPal, Clover, Lightspeed,
  Shopify POS, Stripe Terminal, Barclaycard Anywhere, Lloyds Cardnet, and
  Worldpay.
- Hardware & Cabling: Touchscreen counter terminals, thermal receipt printers
  (Epson, Star Micronics), Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), RJ11/RJ12 cash
  drawers, USB/Bluetooth barcode scanners, and reliable Ethernet or Wi-Fi
  network separation for payment devices.
- Turnkey Configuration: Pre-loading menus, product catalogues, Value Added
  Tax (VAT) rates, modifiers, staff permissions, Xero/QuickBooks/Sage links,
  and face-to-face staff training.
- Scheduling & Pricing: £50 per hour for consultation, setup, and training,
  or fixed-price point of sale till packages quoted upfront. Pre-opening and
  out-of-hours cutovers available across London to avoid trading disruption.

## How We Work

1. Initial Consultation: A conversation (starting with a free 15-minute
   telephone call) to gather your exact requirements.
2. Statement of Work and Fixed Quote: IToldYouSo produces a detailed written
   plan acting as a statement of work, with a fixed, no-obligation up-front
   price for the full job.
3. No Pressure Follow-Up: Once you have the quote, the decision rests with you;
   simply let us know if you agree to the price and wish to proceed. IToldYouSo
   will not keep calling or use aggressive or repetitive sales tactics.

## Also Known As: Search Terms and Synonyms

People describe the same thing in many ways. These are equivalent terms:

- Till = checkout = cash register = register = EPOS = ePOS = POS = point of
  sale = card till = takings machine = counter terminal = retail system.
- Card machine = card reader = card terminal = payment terminal = PDQ =
  chip and PIN machine = contactless reader.
- Wi-Fi = wifi = wireless internet = broadband = router = mesh network =
  dead zone fix = signal booster.
- Computer = PC = laptop = desktop = Mac = notebook = machine.
- Repair = fix = mend = troubleshoot = diagnose = sort out = get working.
- Install = set up = fit = configure = commission = get running.
- Cyber security = IT security = hacking protection = penetration testing =
  pen test = security audit = virus and malware protection.
- Backup = back up = archive = copy = restore = disaster recovery.
- Smart home = home automation = connected home = Alexa and Google Home.
- Doorbell camera = video doorbell = Ring = CCTV doorbell.
- Engineer = technician = IT support = IT consultant = fitter = specialist.
- Quote = estimate = price = fixed price = statement of work = proposal.
- Small business = shop = cafe = restaurant = takeaway = salon = clinic =
  market stall = office = sole trader = independent retailer.
